llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable granting Gmail app-password access. Prefer a dedicated or low-risk Gmail account, keep the app password out of source control and logs, avoid piping email bodies into broad logs or downstream tools, and review any actual gmail-tool executable before running it because it is not included in this bundle.
